## What's New

- Episode selection opens the current or last-played season and episode, scrolls it into view, and restores remote focus.
- Search removes Discover and its filters. A compact bottom QWERTY keyboard leaves more room for movie and series suggestions, with QR Search and View All.
- New-profile onboarding offers copying another profile's settings while keeping the new theme, or manual setup with 4K TV selection and three language priorities for stream sorting.
- New manual profiles use the requested playback and filtering defaults: 30-second unified seek/thumbnail interval, thumbnails and source memory enabled, automatic source selection, intro skipping, 5-second countdowns, next-episode autoplay with Only IntroDB, complete-season torrents, zero-seeder filtering, and English primary audio/subtitles.
- 4K setup enables tunneled playback and excludes 3D. Non-4K setup disables tunneling and selects every current excluded-format option.
- Subtitle identity collisions are fixed so embedded tracks are not mistaken for OpenSubtitles sidecars. Embedded, Stream and Add-on provenance is displayed separately.

Existing profiles retain their settings. Copy setup inherits settings instead of applying the new defaults.

## Installation And Verification

- Optimized, non-debug **32-bit ARM (`armeabi-v7a`)** APK; Android 8.0 or newer; package `com.saab.tv`.
- Signed with the existing release certificate: install over the previous matching signed release without uninstalling.
- Local verification: 124 unit tests passed; release lint reported zero errors. No Android TV was connected for on-device UI/playback validation.
- GitHub Actions runs unit tests and release lint again before publishing the signed APK and its SHA-256 checksum.
